links.outcome: Model versus emergency physicians on TBSA error and burn depth agreement against expert panel
links.effect: TBSA: model MAE 1.40 vs physician median 0.89 pp; non-inferior (HL median Δ 0.25, upper bound 0.50). Depth: model kappa 0.14 vs physicians 0.65.
links.quote: In contrast, depth agreement versus the panel was slight for the model (quadratic-weighted kappa 0.14), with systematic underestimation of deeper burns, while physician consensus showed substantially higher agreement (quadratic-weighted kappa 0.65).

unlisted_practices: Non-inferiority benchmarking of a general-purpose multimodal LLM against physician median with a prespecified margin
Standardized three-view photograph protocol for image-based AI assessment

screen.reason: Prospective diagnostic agreement study comparing a multimodal large language model to emergency physicians on photographic burn size and depth assessment; it evaluates model diagnostic performance against clinicians rather than evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
